description: Leave Chat Room feature - Add a 'Leave' button in the room settings modal that calls DELETE /api/v1/dm/chat_rooms/:uuid, removes the room from Redux store, and navigates back to room list.
steps: 1. In app/javascript/mastodon/actions/dm.ts: Add a new action constant DM_CHAT_ROOM_LEFT and a leaveChatRoom thunk that calls apiDeleteDmChatRoom(roomUuid) from api/dm.ts, dispatches DM_CHAT_ROOM_LEFT with the roomUuid, and navigates (the component will handle navigation).
2. In app/javascript/mastodon/reducers/dm.ts: Handle DM_CHAT_ROOM_LEFT action - remove the room from chatRooms.items, remove its uuid from chatRooms.orderedIds, and clean up messages[roomUuid].

3. In app/javascript/mastodon/features/dm/components/room_settings_modal.tsx: Add a 'Leave conversation' section at the bottom with a red-styled button. On click, show a confirm dialog (window.confirm or a simple state-based confirmation). If confirmed, dispatch leaveChatRoom(room.uuid), call onClose(), then history.push('/conversations').

4. Add i18n messages to the modal: 'dm.room_settings.leave' = 'Leave conversation' (en) / '대화방 나가기' (ko), 'dm.room_settings.leave_confirm' = 'Are you sure you want to leave this conversation?' (en) / '정말 나가시겠습니까?' (ko).
5. In app/javascript/mastodon/locales/en.json: Add 'dm.room_settings.leave' and 'dm.room_settings.leave_confirm' entries in alphabetical order within the 'dm.room_settings' section.
6. In app/javascript/mastodon/locales/ko.json: Add matching Korean translations.
7. In app/javascript/styles/mastodon/dm.scss: Add styles for the leave button (red/danger color scheme, similar to destructive buttons in Mastodon).
acceptance_criteria: A 'Leave conversation' button appears in the room settings modal
After confirming, the DELETE API is called, the room is removed from state, and the user is navigated to /conversations
TypeScript compiles without errors (npx tsc --noEmit on relevant files)
verification: Check that the leave button and confirm strings exist in both en.json and ko.json
Verify the reducer handles DM_CHAT_ROOM_LEFT correctly by code review
findings: TypeScript compiles without errors. All changes verified: action constant + thunk in actions/dm.ts, reducer case in reducers/dm.ts, leave button in room_settings_modal.tsx, locale strings in en.json and ko.json, styles in dm.scss.
